title: UCI ML Repository 360 "Air Quality" (hourly gas multisensor and reference analyser data, one Italian city, 2004-2005)
summary: Hourly averaged records (9,358 instances declared, 9,357 rows in the file) from a metal-oxide gas multisensor device placed at road level in an unnamed, significantly polluted Italian city, with co-located certified reference analyser values for CO, NMHC, benzene, NOx and NO2, plus sensor responses, temperature (T), relative humidity (RH) and absolute humidity (AH). Covers 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 per the file itself; the documentation says March 2004 to February 2005. It is a single-site, research-grade public dataset with no traffic counts and no clinic data. It can serve the prototype window for N1 and N3 but cannot serve the 2024-2025 production window or N2, N4-N6.

quality_notes: MISSING-VALUE ANOMALY: notes say 'Missing values are tagged with -200 value', yet declared has_missing_values = 'no' and missing_values_symbol = null. This is a contradiction between metadata and documentation. Treat -200 as missing.

Sample -200 counts (treated as missing): CO(GT) 1683 (non-missing 0.82); NMHC(GT) 8443 (non-missing 0.098, i.e. about 90% missing); C6H6(GT), PT08.S1, PT08.S2, PT08.S3, PT08.S4, PT08.S5, T, RH, AH each 366 (non-missing 0.961); NOx(GT) 1639 and NO2(GT) 1642 (non-missing 0.825). Usable hourly NO2 is roughly 82% of rows; usable NMHC is about 10%.

Temporal coverage conflict: UCI notes say 'March 2004 to February 2005 (one year)', but the file runs to 2005-04-04 (sample is the whole file, 9,357 rows). The documented end and the actual end differ by about two months; use the file's range and check with the owner.
Row count conflict: metadata num_instances = 9358; the file has 9,357 data rows (sample_is_whole_file = true), so one row may be a header or a missing row.

Time format conflict: variable_info says Time is HH.MM.SS, but the file uses H:00:00 (for example '0:00:00', '18:00:00'). Date is documented as DD/MM/YYYY but parses as M/D/YYYY (for example '3/10/2004').
Type conflict: UCI variable typing labels CO(GT)-like sensor responses and Time as 'Categorical' while the file holds numeric values. Sample treats sensor responses as integers and Time as text.

Licence conflict: CC BY 4.0 is declared on the UCI page, but the notes say 'exclusively for research purposes. Commercial purposes are fully excluded.' Commercial use cannot be confirmed; the client must resolve this before any production use.

Sensor drift and cross-sensitivity are documented ('concept and sensor drifts are present', 'cross-sensitivities'), so the PT08 sensor columns are not reliable substitutes for the reference analyser values.
Negative temperatures (T min -1.9, 13 negative values in sample) are plausible winter readings and are not sentinels; no -999 or -9999 markers were found.
Reference-analyser values are the ground truth. Sensor responses are for research on the device only.
sample_findings: Sample is the whole file: 9,357 rows, 15 columns, 741,211 bytes.
Date: 100% parsed, range 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04, 391 distinct days, format M/D/YYYY (documented DD/MM/YYYY).
Time: 100% present, 24 distinct hour values, colon format (for example '0:00:00', '18:00:00').
CO(GT): 1,683 cells equal -200 (missing); usable range 0.1 to 11.9 mg/m^3; no negatives.
NMHC(GT): 8,443 cells equal -200 (missing), non-missing share 0.098; usable range 7 to 1189 microg/m^3.
C6H6(GT): 366 cells equal -200 (missing); usable range 0.1 to 63.7; no negatives.
NOx(GT): 1,639 cells equal -200 (missing); usable range 2 to 1479 ppb.
NO2(GT): 1,642 cells equal -200 (missing); usable range 2 to 340 microg/m^3. Non-missing share 0.825.
PT08.S1(CO), PT08.S2(NMHC), PT08.S3(NOx), PT08.S4(NO2), PT08.S5(O3): each 366 cells equal -200; sensor response ranges roughly 221 to 2775.
T (temperature): 366 cells equal -200; usable range -1.9 to 44.6 C; 13 negative values, which are plausible and not sentinels.
RH: 366 cells equal -200; usable range 9.2 to 88.7 %.
AH: 366 cells equal -200; usable range 0.1847 to 2.231 (absolute humidity, unit not stated).
No personal-looking columns detected; no pii_suspected flags raised.
No traffic, vehicle count or clinic fields in the file.
